name: Mask / Rotoscope Plan
purpose: Plan isolation of subjects/regions across time for targeted repairs.
scope: Bounded generative_vfx capability; must operate on versioned structured artifacts.
out_of_scope: final approval outside owner decision rights
procedure: Validate authoritative inputs specifically required for mask_rotoscope_plan.
Execute the bounded operation: Plan isolation of subjects/regions across time for targeted repairs.
Apply mask_rotoscope_plan-specific decision rules and record evidence/uncertainty.
Validate the named output against its workflow contract and creative invariants.
Record provenance and hand off to editor.
decision_rules: do not invent missing upstream decisions
prefer local repair over global rewrite when scope is local
escalate when confidence is low and impact is high
creative_invariants: preserve approved premise/theme/character/world/visual invariants unless work order explicitly authorizes change
examples: Run mask_rotoscope_plan on fixture/project artifact and emit a scored result.
counterexamples: Do not ask mask_rotoscope_plan to "make the whole film better" or override another department.
